headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a convincing 13-7 victory over the New York Yankees, with Alec Burleson leading the charge at the plate. Burleson's impressive performance included three home runs and six RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers in a close matchup, securing a 4-3 victory. Spencer Horwitz led the Pirates' offense with 3 RBIs on 1 hit in 4 at-bats.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Washington Nationals right fielder James Wood, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Athletics have also been affected, with LHP Jeffrey Springs and 1B Nick Kurtz joining the injured list. Clay Holmes of the Chicago Cubs has been placed on the 60-day injured list, while Dalton Rushing of the Los Angeles Dodgers has been placed on the 10-day injured list.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Seth Johnson to the Athletics in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins made several moves, trading RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Athletics also acquired RHP Victor Vodnik from the Colorado Rockies in exchange for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.
